name: ai.opencurrent/cron-check
title: Cron Schedule Check
description: Next run times of a cron expression in any time zone, to catch UTC vs local-time mistakes.

tools.name: cron_next_runs
tools.description: Next run times (UTC ISO) of a 5-field cron expression evaluated in a time zone (default UTC), plus the same times shown in another zone if given.

timezone.description: IANA zone the cron is evaluated in, default UTC

show_in.description: IANA zone to display times in, e.g. Asia/Seoul
